text: Astronomy concerns itself with objects and events beyond Earth's atmosphere. The Sun was among the earliest major astronomical discoveries; it is a star delivering light and heat while its gravity anchors all solar system bodies toward its center. Orbiting our planet, the Moon presents craters, mountains, and valleys that scientists analyze to learn about terrestrial geological history. Other worlds exist within this system as well. For example, Mars hosts extensive cratering resulting from meteor strikes and volcanic eruptions. Ultimately, astronomy remains a compelling discipline enabling humanity to comprehend the cosmos and its mechanisms.
